title: Fluorescent Focus Unit Assay using LICOR Imaging System
author: Bernardo Mainou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k8fcztn
materials: Plates and reagents: Corning Black with clear bottom TC treated 96 well plates (Corning #3904) DRAQ5 #4084 from Cell Signaling Sapphire 700 #928-40022 from LICORAntibody 800 from LICOR (Life Technologies secondary antibodies give extra background and should be avoided)

steps.title: Remove media from wells
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard all cell culture media from each well of the plate.

steps.title: Wash once with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 1× volume of Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS) to each well, then remove the PBS.

steps.title: Add ice‑cold methanol
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL ice‑cold methanol into each well.

steps.title: Freeze plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate and store at –20 °C for at least 30 minutes (plates may remain at –20 °C for several weeks).

steps.title: Thaw and evaporate ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove the methanol, allow the plate to come to room temperature, and let any residual ethanol evaporate.

steps.title: Wash with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL PBS to each well, then discard the PBS.

steps.title: Quick DPBS‑Tween wash
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL Dulbecco’s PBS containing 0.5 % Tween‑20 (DPBS‑T) to each well and remove immediately.

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL rabbit anti‑reovirus polyclonal antiserum (1:1000 dilution) in DPBS with 1 % BSA (DPBS‑BSA) to experimental wells; add 50 µL DPBS‑BSA without antibody to background control wells.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 50 µL primary solution into each experimental well.
Pipette 50 µL DPBS‑BSA (no antibody) into each control well.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Remove primary solution
steps.instruction: Discard the DPBS‑BSA (primary) solution from all wells.

steps.title: Wash three times with DPBS‑T
steps.instruction: Wash the wells three times with DPBS‑T, using 5 minutes of shaking for each wash.

steps.title: Add DPBS‑BSA block
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DPBS‑BSA to all wells.

steps.title: Incubate blocking solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Second wash series
steps.instruction: Wash the plates three times with DPBS‑T, each wash lasting 5 minutes with shaking.

steps.title: Prepare cell staining solution
steps.instruction: In DPBS‑BSA, prepare a staining mix containing: secondary antibody (e.g., Goat Anti‑Rabbit LICOR IRDye 800CW) at 1:1000, Draq5 at 1:10 000, and Sapphire700 at 1:1000. (Note: LICOR IRDye 800CW gives lower background than Goat Anti‑Rabbit Alexa 790.)

steps.title: Add staining solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the cell staining solution to all wells that received primary antibody; add 50 µL DPBS‑BSA containing only the secondary antibody (1:1000) to background control wells.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 50 µL staining mix into each primary‑treated well.
Pipette 50 µL DPBS‑BSA with secondary antibody (1:1000) into each control well.

steps.title: Remove staining solution
steps.instruction: Discard the staining solution from all wells.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Wash the wells three times with 150 µL DPBS‑T per wash.

steps.title: Add water before imaging
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL sterile water to each well.

steps.title: Scan plates on LICOR
steps.instruction: Image the plates using the LICOR Odyssey Imaging System with the following settings: Focus offset = 3.0 (adjust per plate), 700 nm intensity = 6.5, 800 nm intensity = 7.5.
